title: Crispy Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: Brussels sprouts roasted cut side down until deeply caramelized and crisp, then tossed with honey, balsamic-style vinegar and chili.

image.alt: Halved roasted Brussels sprouts on a sheet pan

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} with a rack in the lower third.
Toss the sprouts with the oil and salt, then arrange them cut side down on the baking sheet with space between.
Roast without stirring until the cut sides are deep brown and the sprouts are tender, {time 20-25 min}.
Whisk the honey, vinegar and pepper flakes, drizzle over the hot sprouts and toss.

notes: Cut side down against the hot pan is what gives them their dark, sweet crust.
Use maple syrup instead of honey for a vegan side.
